panelLabel.where: Setlist editor head (band tenants): screen-reader name of the gig details row

panelLoadIn.where: Setlist editor head and Perform head (band tenants): load-in time, e.g. 'Load-in 17:00'

panelSoundcheck.where: Setlist editor head and Perform head (band tenants): soundcheck time

panelShow.where: Setlist editor head and Perform head (band tenants): show start and end times

panelStart.where: Setlist editor head and Perform head (band tenants): show start time when no end time is set

panelEnd.where: Setlist editor head and Perform head (band tenants): show end time when no start time is set

panelEdit.where: Setlist editor head (band tenants): button that opens the gig details editor

panelEmpty.where: Setlist editor head (band tenants): button shown when no venue or times are set yet

statusTotal.where: Setlist editor and Perform head status line: the running length of the whole gig

setTarget.where: Section band (editor, Perform): the set's target length after its running length, e.g. '38:20 · target 45:00'

setOver.where: Section band (editor, Perform): how far the set runs past its target, e.g. '3:20 over'

setUntimed.where: Section band (editor, Perform): number of songs in the set that have no length yet

setTotalAria.where: Section band (editor, Perform): screen-reader text before the set's running length

durationAria.where: Setlist editor row (band tenants): screen-reader name of the inline length field

durationAriaUntitled.where: Setlist editor row (band tenants): screen-reader name of the inline length field on an untitled row

durationPlaceholder.where: Setlist editor row (band tenants): placeholder in the inline length field (minutes:seconds)
durationPlaceholder.context: A format hint: minutes, colon, two digits of seconds

durationInvalid.where: Setlist editor row (band tenants): message when the typed length cannot be read

segueToggle.where: Setlist editor row (band tenants): screen-reader name of the segue (→) toggle button

segueMark.where: Perform setlist row: screen-reader text for the → segue mark

singerKeysHeading.where: Setlist editor row detail (band tenants): heading over the list of singer → key

singerName.where: Setlist editor row detail: label of the singer name field

singerKey.where: Setlist editor row detail: label of the singer's key field

singerKeyNone.where: Setlist editor row detail: empty choice in the singer key picker
singerKeyNone.context: A dash meaning no key chosen yet

addSinger.where: Setlist editor row detail: button that adds a singer → key line

removeSinger.where: Setlist editor row detail: screen-reader name of the button removing a singer line

removeSingerUntitled.where: Setlist editor row detail: screen-reader name of the button removing a singer line with no name yet

singerKeysDuplicate.where: Setlist editor row detail: message when the same singer is listed twice

leadKeyHint.where: Setlist editor and Perform row: screen-reader text on the key tag when it shows the lead singer's key

sheetGigHeading.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): heading over the gig fields

fieldVenue.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the venue field

fieldAddress.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the address field

fieldLoadIn.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the load-in time field

fieldSoundcheck.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the soundcheck time field

fieldStart.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the show start time field

fieldEnd.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the show end time field

fieldContact.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the free-text venue contact field

fieldNotes.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of the gig notes field

setTargetsHeading.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): heading over the per-set target length fields

setTargetsHint.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): hint under the set lengths heading

setTargetLabel.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): label of one set's target-minutes field
setTargetLabel.context: {set} is the set's header title (data), e.g. 'Set 1'

setUntitled.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): stands in for a set header that has no title

gigInvalid.where: Setlist details sheet (band tenants): message when a gig field cannot be saved

showSheet.where: Print dialog (band tenants): button that downloads the one-page show sheet

showSheetHint.where: Print dialog (band tenants): hint under the show sheet button

showSheetFailed.where: Print dialog (band tenants): error when the show sheet download fails
